newsitem.title: GERMANY: German roaster enquiry thin, interest for 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: German roaster enquiry thin, interest for 2nd half.

text.p: German physical coffee markets remained quiet as roasters were well covered for nearby months and focussed on the second half of 1997, traders said on Monday.
"Maybe there will be some trade short-covering for May/June shipment but the interest is clearly focused on the second half, for which there are no origin offers," one said.
July/August shipment coffees were not forthcoming, which traders said should be reflected in a higher Sept positon on the New York arabica futures exchange, traders said.
But technical factors were currently overriding fundamentals, which did not inspire consumers trust, they said.
Firm differentials and a strong dollar versus the mark also discouraged business.

In the import market, some May/June and Aug/Nov shipment Brazils were placed, as differentials were relativly favourable. Brazils were $203 per 50 kg fob May/June, Colombians $255, Kenyans $302 and Vietnam G-2 robustas $76 cif.
